hook: Nineteen numbers, fifteen lines, one impossible-seeming sum

beats.say: Arrange the numbers one to nineteen in a honeycomb so all fifteen straight lines add up to the same total. That total has to be 38.
Up to rotation and reflection there is exactly one solution, with five in the center, and no larger magic hexagon exists.
Railway clerk Clifford Adams started on it in 1910 and finally found it in 1957, decades after others had found and lost it.
